recommendation: Retain the independent per-route warmup recovery in the report-only HIP-3 index observer supervisor. Continue checking exact cursor advancement at 15-minute boundaries; do not restart the live backend for this observer-only recovery.
why_now: The SP500 and SPCX report-only observers stopped after source retry exhaustion. Their supervisor then terminated during recovery because one unready route could exhaust the shared warmup while a sibling route had already advanced, leaving live SP500 readiness stale for more than two hours.
evidence_reviewed: The terminal supervisor status and both stale route checkpoints.
The supervisor process tree showing no child observers before recovery.
The supervisor warmup and restart implementation.
Deterministic RED/GREEN tests for a stalled route beside an advancing sibling.
The complete non-network Python regression suite.
Credential-free isolated public-source probes for SP500 and SPCX.
The real 18:15 UTC supervisor, route checkpoint, live routing, position, and protection boundary.

observed_problem_or_opportunity.previous_supervisor_fault: index observers did not publish fresh status within warmup

root_cause.mechanism: The supervisor waited on all unready children as one warmup group. After a source-retry restart, an advancing child could become healthy while a stalled sibling remained pending; the shared warmup then raised a terminal error immediately, killed both children, and bypassed the configured per-route restart budget.
root_cause.distinction_from_prior_incident: This is independent route warmup failure, not the previously repaired transient journal/status/cursor mixed-publication race.
root_cause.falsifier: A deterministic replay in which a stalled child beside an advancing sibling consumes its configured per-route restart budget without the repair, or evidence that the observed terminal fault arose outside warmup handling, would invalidate this attribution.

applicable_market_regime: All regimes; this is process supervision and source availability, not a market-regime, entry, exit, sizing, or leverage change.

alternatives_considered.tradeoff: Leaves both index routes unavailable after a recoverable one-route warmup stall.
Can restore service temporarily but retains the deterministic shared-warmup failure.
Needlessly interrupts a healthy sibling and increases correlated outage risk.
Selected because it preserves the healthy sibling, uses the existing per-route budget, and still terminates fail-closed when a route exhausts that budget.

behavior: Mark each pending child ready as soon as its own checkpoint advances.
After the warmup bound, stop and replace only the still-unready child.
Use the existing maximum-restarts-per-route budget for warmup failures.
Preserve cursor non-regression, append-only journal checks, bounded restart reset, and fail-closed health validation.

expected_upside: Recover independent SP500/SPCX report-only data routes after bounded source stalls without interrupting a healthy sibling, weakening live entry checks, or replaying missed decisions.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: A persistently broken route can still exhaust its three-restart budget and terminate the supervisor; this is intentional fail-closed behavior.
The supervisor process itself has no independent outer service manager; process-presence monitoring remains necessary.
Source recovery can censor missed historical boundaries; it must not convert them into retroactive entries.
Technical availability does not establish positive SP500 or SPCX expectancy.
success_metrics: Each route restarts independently when only that route fails warmup.
A healthy sibling remains running during the other route's bounded recovery.
Both status cursors advance to each new completed 15-minute boundary without regression.
No live entry is authorized from stale, retroactive, or incoherent observer evidence.
Persistent route failure consumes a bounded per-route budget and produces an explicit terminal fault.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: One unready route terminates or restarts a healthy sibling before exhausting its own budget.
Any cursor regression, journal replacement, identity mismatch, restart-budget bypass, or success-shaped stale status.
Any missed historical decision is replayed as a live action.
Any live runtime fault, missing protective stop, or stale TUI readiness caused by this repair.
rollback_plan: Stop the report-only supervisor, restore the prior implementation from the verified project backup or source history, and keep both index providers fail-closed until a replacement passes deterministic sibling-isolation tests and a real 15-minute boundary. Do not restart or alter the live backend as part of observer rollback.

confidence_level.implementation_behavior: high after deterministic and real-boundary validation

explicit_approval_requested: None. This was a report-only technical recovery under existing remediation authority; no live backend restart and no strategy, exit, risk, sizing, or leverage change was performed.
